authentication_posture.note: multi-source adjudication consumes already-assessed local states; it does not verify NTS, symmetric keys, or packet transcripts and does not strengthen profile conformance from authentication reports.

clock_continuity_posture.note: multi-source adjudication does not prove application monotonic-clock behavior

rate_error_bound.basis: input evaluators retain adapter-local rate bounds; adjudicator does not narrow rate error

source_diversity_posture.note: overlapping assessed intervals agree, but at least one input reported same-root/common-mode source posture; do not treat overlap as independent diversity

time_error_bound.basis: intersection of overlapping local-assessed-state intervals; union when fail-closed

timescale_realization.note: adjudication preserves input UTC claims but does not prove a named UTC realization or leap-smear policy

profile_assessments.note: Generated by tools/multisource_adjudicator.py from already-assessed local states; weakest lane and interval relation are carried forward.

policy_acceptance.reason: all input assessed intervals overlap; output interval is the intersection and profile lane is the weakest input lane
